segments.label: Give this place a memory
segments.action: Open on the remembered environment and State v1.
segments.voiceover: Physical places usually have no persistent machine memory. SENTINEL gives them one.

segments.label: Observe
segments.action: Show the baseline photo and immutable state creation context without waiting on a new scan.
segments.voiceover: A visual observation becomes an immutable environmental state, grounded to evidence rather than a disposable image description.

segments.label: Remembered
segments.action: Show v1, v2 and v3 in immutable history while keeping focus on State v1.
segments.voiceover: Now this office remembers what was here and keeps the earlier state intact.

segments.label: Evidence
segments.action: Briefly show grounded objects or evidence references.
segments.voiceover: Objects, conditions and answers stay connected to the evidence that supports them.

segments.label: Introduce physical change
segments.screen: State v1 and State v2 scene images
segments.action: Show cardboard boxes entering the exit access area.
segments.voiceover: Then reality changes: cardboard boxes enter the exit access area.

segments.label: Reality Diff
segments.action: Hold the before/after surface, Emergency exit access obstructed, and New: Cardboard Boxes.
segments.voiceover: SENTINEL compares remembered states. This is Reality Diff — a Git diff for the physical world.

segments.label: Priority
segments.action: Show the grounded conclusion, State v2, related boxes and exit door.
segments.voiceover: Because the system has memory, I can ask which change matters most. It prioritizes the blocked exit from the current grounded state.

segments.label: Action Plan
segments.action: Show Clear obstruction and the single deterministic Rescan to verify handoff.
segments.voiceover: The Action Plan stays recommendation-only: clear the obstruction, then rescan. SENTINEL never pretends the work happened.

segments.label: Fix and rescan
segments.screen: State v2 → State v3 physical comparison
segments.action: Show the same exit area after the boxes are removed.
segments.voiceover: After the boxes are removed, the same exit context is observed again.

segments.label: Verified
segments.action: Show Verified, 1 resolved, 0 remaining, 0 inconclusive and the positive-current-evidence explanation.
segments.voiceover: Verification requires positive current evidence. Missing is not enough. The path is visibly clear, so the earlier obstruction is Verified as resolved.

segments.label: Nebius NVIDIA proof
segments.action: Show Nebius Token Factory provider and NVIDIA Nemotron reasoning role for only a few seconds.
segments.voiceover: The live inference path runs through Nebius Token Factory, with NVIDIA Nemotron handling grounded reasoning and action planning.

segments.label: Close
segments.action: Return to the product and end cleanly.
segments.voiceover: SENTINEL: AI memory for the physical world.
